new_urls.question: Which JSON-RPC methods must a hosted MCP server answer with no token before a directory will list it?
new_urls.evidence: Live probes of mcp.zovo.one 2026-09-09 (initialize/tools/list/resources/list/ping 200, tools/call 401, wrong token 401); the method split read from remote/src/index.ts; registry issue 1626 population figures (16,305 endpoints, 25.4% require auth); glama.ai/mcp/methodology 2.2 for the introspection exchange.

new_urls.question: What happens when two server names declare the same remote URL?
new_urls.evidence: validateNoDuplicateRemoteURLs in internal/service/registry_service.go, quoted from the main branch 2026-09-09; the 400 measured on 2026-09-08 in docs/NAMESPACE_R1.md; third-party issues 1302, 890, 1317, 1204, 1193, 1485; registry FAQ on unpublishing.

new_urls.question: Does the capitalisation of my GitHub username affect my registry rank?
new_urls.evidence: Live result sets 2026-09-09: names == sorted(names) True and case-insensitive sort False on the search=_ page; consecutive io.github rows on pdf, invoice and late; ILIKE and ORDER BY quoted from internal/database/postgres.go; search=% returns 0 and slack/Slack/SLACK each return 20.

new_urls.question: How many MCP servers already have my word in the name?
new_urls.evidence: 29 tokens measured against the live registry 2026-09-09 at limit=100&version=latest, every result set byte-order sorted, full table in this file.

new_urls.question: Which server.json fields exist and which limits fail a publish?
new_urls.evidence: The published schema at static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/2025-12-11/server.schema.json, fetched and parsed 2026-09-09; the registry versioning, remote-servers and FAQ pages read the same day; registry issue 1579.

new_urls.question: When a tool fails, do I return a JSON-RPC error or a result with isError?
new_urls.evidence: The tools section of the MCP specification revision 2026-07-28, fetched 2026-09-09; both example payloads are the specification's own.

new_urls.question: What do outputSchema and structuredContent oblige a server to do?
new_urls.evidence: Same specification page: servers MUST conform, clients SHOULD validate, SHOULD also return serialized JSON as text, 2020-12 default, the no-parameter inputSchema forms, resultType and input_required.

new_urls.question: What are the rules for an MCP tool name, and what happens when two servers use the same one?
new_urls.evidence: Specification 2026-07-28 tool-name rules and the disambiguation guidance including serverInfo not being unique; tool counts measured on seven live endpoints 2026-09-09; glama.ai/mcp/methodology 1.6; the 2KB description truncation verified on docs.claude.com 2026-09-09.

new_urls.question: MCP has no session, so how do two tool calls share state?
new_urls.evidence: The non-normative stateful-tools section of specification 2026-07-28; the streamable HTTP page's own list of what revision 2026-07-28 removed, fetched 2026-09-09; this project's hosted token form.

new_urls.question: What is x-mcp-header and what happens if I get it wrong?
new_urls.evidence: Specification 2026-07-28 tools page: the Mcp-Param-{name} mapping, the six MUST constraints, the client MUST exclude an invalid tool from tools/list, and the warning against mirroring secrets.

new_urls.question: How is an MCP server scored by a directory, and which tool decides the score?
new_urls.evidence: glama.ai/mcp/methodology sections 1.3 and 1.6 read 2026-09-09; the formula and tiers from a listed server's score page as recorded in data/glama_r2.json; license_activate the minimum tool on 20 of 20 connectors, n=20 min 1.4 max 3.1 mean 2.26 against 4.12 for license_status, scored 2026-09-08.

new_urls.question: What do AI crawlers fetch that Googlebot does not?
new_urls.evidence: Edge request logs for mcp.zovo.one, 165 hours ending 2026-09-09, joined to the 141-URL sitemap; 16 named crawlers; Google index status from one URL Inspection API call per URL the same day. Both in data/indexation.json.

new_urls.question: Why does the URL Inspection API give a different coverage state for the same URL?
new_urls.evidence: Two full 141-URL censuses 15 minutes apart on 2026-09-09 with the same key and property: 82 of 141 changed coverageState, 76 in one direction and 6 in the other, while in_google_index and ever_crawled_by_google were identical. Recorded in data/indexation.json.
